# meca-antorchas-fuego (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F7, Templo del Fuego), A: both ADULT at the entrance; the torch rooms solved (rooms 04 and 12), the room 13 fire.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 13-fuego
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 221
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag FireTemple_Room04_GimmickClear \(0x16ca2911\) = 1: queued within enciende..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x16ca2911 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende..end
#! expect A coop: test flag FireTemple_Room12_GimmickClear \(0x607500aa\) = 1: queued within enciende2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x607500aa \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende2..end
#! expect A coop: test flag FireTemple_Room13_FireOn \(0x403407e5\) = 1: queued within enciende3..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x403407e5 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende3..end
mark start
warp FireTemple FireTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark enciende
flag FireTemple_Room04_GimmickClear 1
wait 300
mark enciende2
flag FireTemple_Room12_GimmickClear 1
wait 300
mark enciende3
flag FireTemple_Room13_FireOn 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
